# InRome Cooking

> > InRome Cooking offers authentic Italian cooking classes, food tours, and cultural experiences in Rome, Trastevere, Tuscany, and Castel Gandolfo.

Based near the Pantheon on Corso del Rinascimento and Via Giustiniani, InRome Cooking provides hands-on culinary education and guided food experiences throughout Rome's historic neighborhoods. The company specializes in pasta making, pizza classes, gelato workshops, and immersive food tours exploring local markets and traditional trattorias.

## Key Topics

- Rome cooking classes
- Italian food tours
- Trastevere neighborhood
- Pizza making workshops
- Gelato making classes
- Pasta making lessons
- Private culinary tours
- Tuscany day trips
- Pope's Farm (Castel Gandolfo)
- Golf cart sightseeing
- Wine tasting experiences
- Night food tours
- Market tours
- Pantheon area
- Authentic Italian cuisine
